p4_b7.ocr: Discussion In this paper, we first look into the binary classification of different imaginary movements such as MI-GRASP, MI-ELBOW, and MI-ELBOW-GOAL. Then, the possibility of designing a 3-class BCI that discriminates rest, imaginary grasp movements, and imaginary elbow move- ments is investigated.
